annotations.title: Can I sell it? Gated ASIN/brand check

description: READ-ONLY. Gated products: BEFORE listing or buying stock, tells whether THIS seller account can sell each ASIN on the outpost's marketplace (or other marketplaces of the same region) in a given condition, using Amazon's Listings Restrictions API (getListingsRestrictions). Per ASIN: libero (no restriction) / serve_approvazione (APPROVAL_REQUIRED, with Amazon's approval_links to Seller Central) / non_idoneo (NOT_ELIGIBLE, no path to unlock) / asin_non_trovato (ASIN_NOT_FOUND on that marketplace). Results are GROUPED BY BRAND (brand read from the Amazon catalog, cached) with a verdict per brand (da_sbloccare / non_vendibile / libero) and a summary for the user; when a brand needs approval the response includes unlock_guide (what Amazon usually asks: invoices from the manufacturer or an authorized distributor, last 180 days, addressed to the seller account's legal name/address; or the brand's LOA / Reseller role in Brand Registry). Accepts asins[] OR identifiers[] (EAN/UPC/GTIN from a supplier file: converted to ASIN via the catalog, unmatched codes listed in unresolved_identifiers). Max 100 codes per call; ~4 calls/s, so 100 ASIN take ~25 s: if status is 'partial', call again with next_call.arguments (pending_asins). The approval request itself CANNOT be sent via API: give the user the approval_links. Use this for 'can I sell these products?', 'which brands do I need to get ungated?', 'is brand X gated for me?'. For listings already uploaded and blocked use list_inactive_listings / get_listing_issues (QUALIFICATION_REQUIRED). Not available for Vendor outposts.

account_id.description: ID dell'outpost Amazon (= un seller su uno specifico marketplace; vedi list_clients). Opzionale se il token è legato a un solo outpost.

asins.description: ASIN da controllare (max 100). Accetta anche una stringa separata da virgole/a capo.

identifier_type.description: Tipo dei codici in identifiers (default EAN).

identifiers.description: In alternativa/aggiunta: codici EAN/UPC/GTIN (es. dal listino fornitore), convertiti in ASIN con il catalogo Amazon del marketplace dell'outpost (max 100 in totale con asins).

include_brand.description: Default true: legge il brand dal catalogo per raggruppare. false = più veloce, tutto sotto "brand sconosciuto".

marketplace_ids.description: Marketplace da controllare (max 5, stessa region dell'outpost, es. APJ6JRA9NG5V4 = amazon.it, A1PA6795UKMFR9 = amazon.de). Default: il marketplace dell'outpost.

reason_locale.description: Lingua dei messaggi Amazon (es. it_IT); default = lingua del primo marketplace.

name: check_listing_restrictions
